message.content: {"note_claim": "Congress explicitly granted the executive branch the authority to designate, extend, or terminate Temporary Protected Status (TPS) under 8 U.S. Code § 1254a.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "If the Attorney General determines under subparagraph (A) that a foreign state (or part of such foreign state) no longer continues to meet the conditions for designation under paragraph (1), the Attorney General shall terminate the designation", "reason": "The statute text shows Congress gave the executive (Attorney General) authority to designate, extend, and terminate TPS, and bars judicial review of such determinations."}

parsed.note_claim: Congress explicitly granted the executive branch the authority to designate, extend, or terminate Temporary Protected Status (TPS) under 8 U.S. Code § 1254a.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: If the Attorney General determines under subparagraph (A) that a foreign state (or part of such foreign state) no longer continues to meet the conditions for designation under paragraph (1), the Attorney General shall terminate the designation
parsed.reason: The statute text shows Congress gave the executive (Attorney General) authority to designate, extend, and terminate TPS, and bars judicial review of such determinations.
